label: Mercury
description: Accounts, transactions, payments, recipients, customers and invoices

operations.name: list_accounts
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of accounts. Supports cursor-based pagination with limit, order, start_after, and end_before query parameters.

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Get account by ID

operations.name: list_transactions
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all transactions across all accounts. Supports advanced filtering by date ranges, status, categories, and cursor-based pagination.

operations.name: list_account_transactions
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of transactions for a specific account. Supports filtering by date range, status, and search terms.

operations.name: get_transaction
operations.description: Retrieve a single transaction by its ID. Returns full transaction details including attachments, check images, and related metadata.

operations.name: update_transaction
operations.description: Update the note and/or category of an existing transaction. Use null values to clear existing data.

operations.name: list_recipients
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all recipients. Use cursor parameters (start_after, end_before) for pagination.

operations.name: get_recipient
operations.description: Retrieve details of a specific recipient by ID

operations.name: create_recipient
operations.description: Create a new recipient for making payments

operations.name: update_recipient
operations.description: Update an existing recipient's information

operations.name: delete_recipient
operations.description: Delete a specific recipient by ID. Fails if the recipient is blocked by scheduled payments, pending approvals, or active ACH authorizations.

operations.name: send_money
operations.description: Send money from an account to a recipient. Creates a transaction that will be processed immediately or may require approval.

operations.name: create_transfer
operations.description: Transfer funds between two accounts within the same organization. Supports transfers between depository accounts (checking/savings), from a depository account to a treasury/investment account, and from a treasury/investment account to a depository account. Creates paired debit and credit transactions.

operations.name: list_customers
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of customers. Supports cursor-based pagination with limit, order, start_after, and end_before query parameters.

operations.name: get_customer
operations.description: Retrieve details of a specific customer by their ID

operations.name: create_customer
operations.description: Create a new customer for the organization

operations.name: update_customer
operations.description: Update an existing customer

operations.name: delete_customer
operations.description: Delete a customer. This action cannot be undone.

operations.name: list_invoices
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of invoices. Supports cursor-based pagination with limit, order, start_after, and end_before query parameters.

operations.name: get_invoice
operations.description: Retrieve details of an invoice by its ID

operations.name: create_invoice
operations.description: Create a new invoice for the organization

operations.name: update_invoice
operations.description: Update an existing invoice

operations.name: cancel_invoice
operations.description: Cancel an invoice. This action cannot be undone.

operations.name: list_account_statements
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of monthly statements for a depository account. For IO credit accounts, use getCreditAccountStatements. Supports cursor-based pagination with limit, order, start_after, and end_before query parameters, as well as date range filtering with start and end parameters.

operations.name: get_organization
operations.description: Retrieve information about your organization including EIN, legal business name, and DBAs.
